package.name: aav_gps_heading_rs
package.description: gps_heading in Rust (rclrs): the default since 19 Nov (Ben, 16 Nov: "lets remove python were possible"), in place of aav_gps_heading's Python node (removed 20 Nov). The same node name, topics and parameters: the GPS receiver's velocity and the wheels in, the car's heading out on /localization/gps/heading for the global EKF. The maths is the gps-heading-core crate, with no ROS, checked to the bit against course.py's answers.
